title: Some movements began with hugging trees
sources: NCERT Class 12, Politics in India since Independence, ch. 'Rise of Popular Movements'

lines.say: Not all politics happens in Parliament.
Some of it happens in forests and villages.

beats.say: Not all politics happens in Parliament. Some of it happens in forests and villages.

lines.say: Chipko began in 1973, when villagers in the Himalaya hugged trees to stop logging.
The Narmada Bachao Andolan opposed big dams. The M-K-S-S in Rajasthan pushed for the right to information.
